All reports are sorted in chronological order, from the oldest ones on top to the newest or future values on the bottom. The calendar is simple but contains all the necessary information — the report’s time and company name, estimated and actual EPS, surprise, and the company’s market capitalization. Clicking on any of the financial metrics will sort the report in the table. [...] With buttons on the upper panel, you can customize the calendar — choose a time period, country, and time zone to see only those reports that suit your strategy. This way, you can decide to see only the earnings of US companies or track reports globally. When all is set, you can easily shift through the calendar to plan your next move.

You can follow companies' earnings in more detail on corresponding symbol pages. Track Tesla's earnings, Amazon's earnings, and even more. [...] # Calendar

## How to use the Earnings Calendar?

TradingView’s Earnings Calendar shows the latest and upcoming earnings reports released by companies. As an important indicator of a company’s financial state, earnings per share are one of the most followed metrics among traders, so the calendar above can serve as a powerful tool for analysis.
